description: The canonical memory epoch: from this point every memory byte leaving or entering Cursor-Governance crosses the l9-graphite-memory control plane, and the provider is a projection memory owns. Written at campaign stage C10 of CURSOR_GOVERNANCE_MEMORY_CONTROL_PLANE_REALIGNMENT_BUILD_PLAN; read by tests/ops/memory/test_canonical_epoch.py. It grants nothing.

epoch.memory_rebound_at: 2026-09-06 (audit closure C14: rebound from the M2 head to the final #56 head with the wheel digest); 2026-09-07 (source ref moved to the v2.3.0 release tag); 2026-09-08 (MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION moved to v2.3.1, first PyPI upload)

authority.provider_role: projection-only; receives records solely through canonical projection
authority.rollback: no rollback path restores a direct provider write (plan §30)

session_lifecycle.secret_plane: no provider URL or bearer on any surface since C9
session_lifecycle.offline_distill: ops/graphiti/distill_queue/worker.py through the control plane since C10
session_lifecycle.generated_data: environment/agents/generated-data/adapters/ingest_memory_candidate.py through the control plane since C10
